heading: top-left
name: 向右出血的直式圖片輪播＋進度條
desc: 左上是區塊標題加旁邊基線對齊的小字；下方的輪播從內容左緣開始、一路延伸到畫面右緣，最右邊的項目被裁切；輪播下方左側是進度條、右側是文字連結。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊，區塊下方的留白明顯大於上方，區塊下緣有一條橫跨畫面寬的分隔線。區塊上方靠左放標題組：標題組包含標題（可多行），標題右側同一行可放一段小字次要文字，和標題基線對齊、沒有外框，沒有時省略；標題是一般尺寸的區塊標題，只比項目的標題大一些，不是超大標題。標題組下方是輪播：左緣對齊頁面內容寬度，右側延伸到畫面右緣，桌機一次露出約三個半項目，最右邊的項目被畫面右緣裁切；可用拖曳橫向切換，不自動播放；項目之間的間距窄，約為圖片寬度的九分之一。標題、輪播第一個項目、進度條的左緣都對齊頁面內容寬度的同一條左緣線。每個項目無外框、等寬：最上方是一行小字次要文字（純文字，沒有外框），下方是直式圖片，圖片下方是標題（可多行），標題下方可放一行小字次要文字，沒有時省略；所有項目的圖片同一比例。輪播下方一列：左側是橫向進度條，從內容左緣延伸到約內容寬度六成，軌道中較深的一段表示目前捲動到的位置；右側可放一個附右箭頭與底線的文字連結，靠右對齊頁面內容寬度，沒有時省略；進度條的軌道和文字連結的底線落在同一條水平線上，看起來像共用同一條底線。
tablet: 平板沿用桌機版，一次露出的項目數量減少，右側仍露出被裁切的項目。
mobile: 輪播改為橫向滑動，邊緣露出下一個項目的一部分：一次露出一個項目，約佔畫面寬的七成並靠左對齊頁面內容寬度，右側露出下一個項目的一部分，延伸到畫面右緣；可用手指左右滑動切換。項目內的組成與標題組不變，標題、第一個項目仍對齊同一條左緣線。進度條改為獨佔一列，左右都比內容寬度略為內縮；文字連結移到進度條下方，靠右。區塊下方的留白仍大於上方，下緣的分隔線保留。

en.name: Right-bleeding portrait image carousel + progress bar
en.desc: A section title with baseline-aligned small text beside it sits at the top left; below it a carousel starts at the content's left edge and extends to the right edge of the screen, cropping the rightmost item; under the carousel is a progress bar on the left and a text link on the right.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content; the spacing below the content is noticeably larger than the spacing above, and a divider spanning the screen width runs along the bottom edge of the section. Place the heading group at the top, aligned left: the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a short piece of small secondary text on the same line to the right of the title, baseline-aligned with the title and without any border; omit it when there is no content. The title is a regular-size section title, only somewhat larger than the item titles, not an oversized headline. Below the heading group is a carousel: its left edge aligns with the page content width and it extends to the right edge of the screen; on desktop about three and a half items are visible, with the rightmost item cropped by the right edge of the screen. Items are switched horizontally by dragging, with no autoplay; the gap between items is narrow, about one ninth of the image width. The left edges of the title, the first carousel item and the progress bar all align on the same left line of the page content width. Each item has no border and all items are equal in width: at the top is one line of small secondary text (plain text, no border), below it a portrait image, below the image a title (may wrap to multiple lines), and optionally one line of small secondary text below the title; omit it when there is no content. All item images share the same aspect ratio. Below the carousel is one row: on the left is a horizontal progress bar running from the left edge of the content to about sixty percent of the content width, where a darker segment of the track shows the current scroll position; on the right, optionally place a text link with a right arrow and an underline, aligned to the right edge of the page content width; omit it when there is no content. The progress bar's track and the text link's underline lie on the same horizontal line, so they read as one shared baseline.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout, with fewer items visible at a time and a cropped item still showing on the right.
en.mobile: The carousel becomes horizontally swipeable, with part of the next item showing at the edge: one item is visible at a time, taking about seventy percent of the screen width and aligned left with the page content width, while part of the next item shows on the right, extending to the right edge of the screen. Items can be switched by swiping left and right. The composition of each item and the heading group stay the same, and the title and first item still share the same left line. The progress bar takes its own row, slightly inset from the page content width on both sides; the text link moves below the progress bar, aligned right. The spacing below the content remains larger than above, and the bottom divider is kept.
